skills.description: Launch Windows console programs (cpolar, updaters, native/Go binaries, python.exe) truly headlessly so no black CMD window flashes — and diagnose "黑框一闪而过" (intermittent black console flash). Covers: why CREATE_NO_WINDOW (0x08000000) alone is NOT enough for programs that attach a conhost console; adding DETACHED_PROCESS (0x00000008); the -log stdout vs -log file symlink permission trap for cpolar; finding the culprit by checking process tree for conhost children; disabling 360ZipUpdaterLoop / removing admin-locked CozeBridge scheduled tasks. Trigger on "黑框一闪"、"闪一个黑框"、"弹窗一闪"、"conhost"、"cpolar 弹窗"、"无窗口启动". Distilled from a real incident where cpolar kept flashing a black console on tunnel reconnect.
skills.description_zh: 在 Windows 上无窗口启动 console 程序（cpolar、更新器、Go/原生程序、python.exe），并诊断"黑框一闪而过"。核心：CREATE_NO_WINDOW(0x08000000) 对会自建 conhost 的程序不够，必须叠加 DETACHED_PROCESS(0x00000008)；cpolar 不能用 -log <文件>（需 symlink 权限，非管理员失败），必须 -log stdout + 重定向；排查黑框先查进程树有无 conhost 子进程；禁用 360ZipUpdaterLoop 等 console 计划任务。源于真实事故：cpolar 隧道重连时黑框反复闪现。
skills.name: Windows 无窗口进程启动与黑框排障
